postgame.what_decided_it: Turnovers. Tampa lost four fumbles and Cincinnati scored a defensive touchdown. The Bengals also won the possession battle 31:25 to 28:35 and went 8-14 on third down.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 25/35, 254 yds, 1 TD, 1 INT. Efficient, not spectacular, 6.8 yards per pass.
Mike Gesicki: 5 rec, 78 yds, 1 TD. Team high in receiving.
Chase Brown: 16 car, 56 yds, 1 TD in a 106-yard rushing day.
postgame.division_meaning: Three-way tie at the top. Baltimore 1-0 at +18, Cincinnati 1-0 at +6, Pittsburgh 1-0 at +7. Cleveland is 0-1 at -24 after losing 34-10 at Jacksonville.
postgame.the_take: Four forced fumbles is not a repeatable plan. Cincinnati only out-gained Tampa 351 to 282 and went 2-5 in the red zone. Clean that up or Houston is a problem.

lines: Baltimore made the loudest statement of Week 1, 41-23 at Indianapolis. Derrick Henry 24 car, 144 yds, 3 TD and Lamar Jackson 324 yards on 17/25.
Bears 59, Panthers 37 in Charlotte. Bryce Young threw for 361 and 3 TD and still lost by 22.

Kansas City handled Denver 31-10 on Monday night, Kenneth Walker III going 23 car, 173 yds, 1 TD. Colts visit Arrowhead next, KC -6.5.
San Francisco is a 13.5-point home favourite over Miami, the biggest spread on the Week 2 board.
